request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Adjutant from the Omega DLC of Mass Effect 3, faithfully matching the supplied final-game references. Reference 1 controls the entire body, full-body pose, camera view and proportions: a hunched asymmetrical creature, tall split dark crest above the pale swollen head sacs, three small blue luminous eyes in a triangle, dark face, tubes hanging from the mouth toward the torso, curved blue-lit rib structures, unequal limbs, a large raised cannon-like right forearm toward image left, a long clawed left arm at image right, and the two irregular digitigrade legs and broad foot tips. Reference 2 is a close-up corroboration for the cannon/hand that is obscured by the attack effect in reference 1: reproduce the exposed round blue center, its ring and the surrounding dark prongs as shown; do not use reference 2 to crop or change the full-body pose. Preserve the reference's dark purple-black and muted brown organic-metal surfaces, pale bluish head sacs, small blue lamps, scarred game texture and exact readable silhouette. Do not turn it into a generic zombie or human, add a new helmet, add limbs, claws, armor, weapons, fresh injuries, fluid, gore or redesigned anatomy. Keep the original-game level of stylized detail and natural occlusion. Remove the large electrical attack arcs and glare, surrounding room, panels, lettering, ground and ground stains; retain only the small contained blue eye/cannon/rib lights belonging to the character itself. No external aura, diffuse glow cloud, outline or long lens flare. The entire crest, cannon prongs, claw fingers and both feet must remain fully inside the frame with at least 10 percent clear margin on all sides. Real transparent alpha background, no floor shadow or pedestal. One complete subject in one view, no sheet, collage, label or border.

notes: Capture principale finale entière inspectée, toutes extrémités cadrées; canon masqué par effet biotique.
Deuxième capture partielle inspectée pour canon sans effet, tête et tuyaux uniquement.
Trois yeux, sacs clairs et crête double confirmés; aucun concept Pariah ou comic substitué.
Anatomie occultée, surface dans l'ombre et fonctionnement du canon non certifiés.
